title: The key column of the blank row is BLANK
query: EVALUATE ADDCOLUMNS ( VALUES ( Product[ProductKey] ), "IsBlank", ISBLANK ( Product[ProductKey] ) )

source.quote: If a relationship is invalid, the VertiPaq engine automatically adds a row containing BLANK in every column of the table on the one-side of the relationship
source.supports: the blank row has BLANK in every column, the key included

source.quote: A Boolean value of TRUE if the value is blank; otherwise FALSE
source.supports: ISBLANK is TRUE for a blank value

source.quote: VALUES includes the blank row caused by an invalid relationship, if present

derivation: VALUES ( Product[ProductKey] ) is 1, 2, 3 and the blank row's BLANK. The orphan key 9 is not a value of Product[ProductKey]. ISBLANK is TRUE only on the blank row.
